question: What are the warnings about exhaust gases?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Cause: Check oil level for overfilling -> Action: Notify unit maintenance if fluid level is high [Manual page 288]
• Cause: Check for restricted air cleaner -> Action: If emergency situation exists, clean air cleaner element (para. 3-15) [Manual page 288]
• Cause: Other causes -> Action: Notify unit maintenance [Manual page 288]

**Other relevant information**
• Be alert at all times for exhaust odors [Manual page 3]
• Be alert for exhaust poisoning symptoms: Headache, Dizziness, Sleepiness, Loss of muscular control [Manual page 3]
• Administer artificial respiration, if necessary [Manual page 3]
• The field protective mask and ambulance Nuclear-Biological-Chemical (NBC) system will not protect you from exhaust poisoning [Manual page 3]

**Limitations**
The table lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
